note: Mission 0 'The Night of Knives': mission lines L1-L14 (said in game through MissionBase.say_line, scripts/campaign/mission_00.gd DIALOGUE) and the cinematic lines C1-C7 (subtitles of m0_fall / m0_dawn, mission_00.gd CINE_LINES). Mission lines have no shot / t. dur = the slot (5 s unless the spec says otherwise). Speaker ids from Speakers.TABLE / cast.json (vey, vessa, hush, narrator, ashby). Text only: the Voice Forge renders the WAVs (task 19.VO0).

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: Stay behind my sword, girl. Knives hate a long reach.
lines.text: Stay behind my sword, girl. Knives hate a long reach.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: I've been stabbed ONE time and I already hate it.
lines.text: I've been stabbed ONE time and I already hate it.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: Good. Light pushes back the dark. Always has.
lines.text: Good. Light pushes back the dark. Always has.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Dogs! Why is it always dogs?
lines.text: Dogs! Why is it always dogs?

lines.speaker: hush
lines.subtitle: Hold still, little queen. It's kinder.
lines.text: Hold still, little queen. It's kinder.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: Over my dead body, knife-woman.
lines.text: Over my dead body, knife-woman.

lines.speaker: hush
lines.subtitle: The old man bites. How charming.
lines.text: The old man bites. How charming.

lines.speaker: hush
lines.subtitle: Another night, little queen. There is always another night.
lines.text: Another night, little queen. There is always another night.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: How many knives does one Bishop OWN?
lines.text: How many knives does one Bishop OWN?

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: Two more hours, girl. Dawn always comes. It's the one thing it's good at.
lines.text: Two more hours, girl. Dawn always comes. It's the one thing it's good at.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: You want me? Come and get me. ALL of you.
lines.text: You want me? Come and get me. ALL of you.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Vey... I'm sorry...
lines.text: Vey... I'm sorry...

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: You're going to explain the lightning.
lines.text: You're going to explain the lightning.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: Later. Duck.
lines.text: Later. Duck.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.subtitle: Vessa, MOVE!
lines.text: Vessa, MOVE!

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: VEY!
lines.text: VEY!

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: ...Malrik.
lines.text: ...Malrik.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: Dawn came to Emberfall, and so did the Emberguard.
lines.text: Dawn came to Emberfall, and so did the Emberguard.

lines.speaker: ashby
lines.subtitle: My queen! You're hurt-
lines.text: My queen! You're hurt-

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: I'm not the one who's hurt, Captain.
lines.text: I'm not the one who's hurt, Captain.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.subtitle: Get the army up. We take the crown today.
lines.text: Get the army up. We take the crown today.
